title: lastrea subnigra
intro: Lastrea subnigra, commonly known as the Black Spleenwort, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea subnigra include its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, while its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal effects. However, further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
